headline: Spot Bitcoin Funds Lose 487 Million as Price Holds Near 84k and Funding Stays Negative
narrative: Spot bitcoin funds lost 487.07 million on the Oct. 7 print, ether funds lost 160.77 million, and solana funds lost 4.8 million, while bitcoin held near 84k. Fear and greed reads 57, labeled greed, and the cycle index is flat at 55, so listed-fund cash left while the mood stayed greedy and the cycle score held its ground. Bitcoin funding is negative at -0.0015, a crowded-short print, the dollar stands at 102.23, and volatility is compressed, with the VIX at 15.33 and seven-day realized volatility at 19.54 against 48.88 over thirty days, so the outflow is meeting shorts and a quiet tape rather than a long chase.
author: jordan
